plan: Queue carry as primary. It is Cuban's best role at 56.3% over 198 games (overall is 51.7%). Set offlane as secondary, not the other way around.
Stop queueing midlane: 46.1% over 245 games is costing real VP. When auto-filled there, play the safest comfort pick, not a learning pick.
Two-hero rule for the climb: Serath and Sparrow. Compared with the average player on the same hero, Cuban wins about 5.6 and 4.6 more games per 100 on them.
Cuban's champion pool is 13+ heroes wide and the top three are only 32% of the games. Gold-to-Platinum climbs are almost always pool-narrowing stories: aim for 70%+ of games on the top three.
The math: Cuban is at 363 VP; Platinum III starts at 900. The all-time peak is 824.
honesty: personal winrates are shrunk toward the player's own average (small heater samples do not count as mains)
field baselines are all-ranks aggregates from our current-patch match sample, not Gold-bracket-specific yet
winrate edges are observational; they say where the player wins, not why

insights.title: The tilt tax is real for Cuban
insights.finding: Right after a loss Cuban wins 50%; right after a win, 67%. One cooldown break after losses is free VP.
insights.receipt: 5/10 after losses vs 8/12 after wins, last 23 games

insights.title: Cuban is running hotter than the career line
